vulnerability.explanation: The loop processes input in chunks of size llen (stride * imagewidth) but only checks that n <= rowsperstrip * llen. If n is not a multiple of llen (e.g., cc provides fewer bytes than a full row), the last iteration still calls horizontalDifference* with n=llen (lines 1348–1360), causing reads past the end of the input buffer bp. This leads to an out-of-bounds read on the final partial chunk.
